summary_1line: Kumbhakarna is put into enchanted sleep while Ravana rampages across the worlds until Kubera sends a messenger urging him toward righteousness.

image_candidates.scene_text: The giant Kumbhakarna sleeps for ages inside a vast crystal-and-gold palace with emerald stairs and bells hanging from ivory galleries.
Ravana rampages through celestial groves like a storm, churning rivers and shaking trees while terrified sages and gods scatter.
Kubera’s messenger bows before the radiant Ravana reclining on a luxurious couch in Lanka’s grand assembly hall.
